items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We opened the show with Ziggy Johnson producing the shows... So the band and Ziggy got along nicely.

ctx.x: Wait a minute, '34, S. H. Dudley, '35, -- '35 with Alexander. '36 with Ziggy and, (unintelligible) Alexander, we played New Year's Eve...
